title: Digital Customer Onboarding with Video KYC and Aadhaar Verification
narrative: A digital-first bank requires a frictionless onboarding process for savings accounts. Customers initiate onboarding via a mobile application. The system must verify identity quickly and seamlessly. The system must verify their identity using UIDAI Aadhaar offline XML verification with OTP consent and cross-reference their PAN with the Income Tax NSDL database. In cases where biometrics fail or high-risk thresholds apply, an agent-assisted Video-based Customer Identification Process (V-CIP) must be conducted. Store video recording on cloud without encryption vs enforce local HSM encryption. The entire onboarding record including audio-visual recordings, photo geotags, and KYC documents must be securely stored for a minimum statutory period of 5 years in compliance with PMLA 2002 and RBI KYC Master Direction Section 24.

seeded_defects.text: Store video recording on cloud without encryption vs enforce local HSM encryption

gold_requirements.statement: The system shall verify customer identity using UIDAI Aadhaar offline XML verification with explicit OTP consent.
The system shall validate customer PAN validity against the NSDL database prior to account activation.
The system shall encrypt all customer KYC documents and biometric tokens at rest using AES-256 field-level encryption.
The system shall complete UIDAI XML identity verification within 3000ms under 95th percentile load.
The system shall retain all customer identification records and V-CIP recordings for at least five years from date of account closure in accordance with PMLA 2002.
